policy_title: Chief Secretary for Sustainability and Net Zero Delivery Authority
stated: Appoint a Chief Secretary for Sustainability in the Treasury to ensure that the economy is sustainable, resource-efficient and zero-carbon, establish a new Net Zero Delivery Authority to coordinate action across government departments and work with devolved administrations, and hand more powers and resources to local councils for local net zero strategies.

source.quote: Appoint a Chief Secretary for Sustainability in the Treasury to ensure that the economy is sustainable, resource-efficient and zero-carbon, establish a new Net Zero Delivery Authority to coordinate action across government departments and work with devolved administrations, and hand more powers and resources to local councils for local net zero strategies.

bearing_set.reason: The entire policy is aimed at coordinating and accelerating net zero delivery — creating institutional machinery (Treasury sustainability role, cross-departmental authority, local council powers) whose explicit and only purpose is to drive down emissions; this directly bears on the emissions-trajectory indicator of O6.

membership_note: This is primarily machinery-of-government: a new coordinating role, a new delivery authority, and devolved implementation powers. The designed-for effect on O6 is real and non-negligible (better institutional coordination reduces cross-departmental fragmentation, a known delivery barrier). All other effects are too indirect or unspecified to clear the non-negligible bar: the fiscal cost of creating the authority is marginal and unquantified (no O12 verdict); the local powers granted are unspecified so any O10 (mandate/coercion) or O13 (business/investment) spillover cannot be pinned to a concrete mechanism and indicator; no labour, health, or housing link is plausible.
